_comment: Triage fixtures for maximum-effort. Tiny work stays with the owner when delegation costs more than execution; bounded lookup goes to a scout; repetitive locked edits go to a mechanic; judgment, design, and risky work stay with the owner. Risky M, original design, and all L work get one frontier review. Forge-state continuation routes to Forge unless Maximum Effort is explicitly requested for a standalone task.
